page.overview:
Who is Muraga Fennes?

Muraga Fennes is one of the two main antagonists (alongside Sterne) of the first season of War of the Visions: Final Fantasy Brave Exvius.

Once the chieftain of the Urca tribe, he subsequently became the king of Fennes, earning infamy for his brutality, being called as the King of Savages for his ruthlessness in combat. He leads a strong offensive against the kingdom of Leonis, whom he seeks to crush at all costs, which puts him in direct opposition with the Leonis royals, specially Mont Leonis as he matures fighting the vicious warlord.

In "Redemption" in "Scene 1 - The Beautiful Steel Maiden", amid their battle with Leonis, Muraga perched atop a rocky cliff, overlooking his soldiers. Muraga was surprised when the esper Ifrit obliterated his squadron, with a shinobi appearing beside him to confirm what he saw. There should not have been anyone in Leonis with the ability to summon an esper, indicating that Machérie was on the battlefield. The shinobi promised to take care of the matter, but Muraga told him to stay out of it as war was for fighting and true pleasure lied in death and bloodbath. He headed to the battlefield where shocked Leonis soldiers surrounded him. Muraga annihilated them with his axe and loudly proclaimed to Oelde that he would take his life for having taken Machérie.

Mont and Lilyth came to a fallen soldier's aid who asked for Mont's forgiveness and explained his wound was Muraga's doing. Lilyth told Mont to take the fallen soldier and leave, as victory was not in their reach. Mont asked if she had no use for him, with Lilyth apologizing and confirming. Mont told Lilyth Muraga was killing soldiers to get Machérie back, and that it was why he could give Muraga no quarter. Lilyth insisted that fighting Muraga would cost Mont his life, to which Mont proclaimed that the Leonis line shall live on, even should they fall afoul of gods to defend it. Mont promised to defeat Muraga, asking Lilyth to lend him her strength. Lilyth would gladly obey as she had swore to be Mont's blade until her dying breath.
